content.text:
Here are the foldable phones that are currently sold in Asia (as of June 20, 2026). Availability varies by country, so tell me your exact country and budget and I’ll tailor picks with local availability and prices.

Top options by current market presence in Asia
- Samsung Galaxy Z Fold7 (and Galaxy Z Flip7)
  - Why consider it: flagship book-style foldable with a very capable camera setup and strong software; widely available across Asian markets.
  - Availability: launched globally in 2025 and sold in many Asian countries (Japan, Singapore, India, UAE, etc.). ([samsungmobilepress.com](https://www.samsungmobilepress.com/press-releases/samsung-launches-galaxy-z-fold7-galaxy-z-flip7-and-galaxy-watch8-series-globally-starting-today/?utm_source=openai))

- OPPO Find N6
  - Why consider it: OPPO’s current crown jewel with “zero-feel crease” engineering and strong productivity features.
  - Availability: global launch on March 17, 2026; now rolling out in Asia (Singapore, UAE, Japan, etc.) with local pre-orders/retail in several markets. ([oppo.com](https://www.oppo.com/en/newsroom/press/oppo-launches-find-n6/?utm_source=openai))

- Vivo X Fold 5
  - Why consider it: excellent foldable in the mid-to-high tier with solid battery life and camera features; often best-value in its class in many Asian markets.
  - Availability: released in 2025 and rolling out to multiple Asian markets (India, Malaysia, Hong Kong, Taiwan, Singapore, Philippines, Indonesia, etc.). ([gadgets360.com](https://www.gadgets360.com/mobiles/news/vivo-x-fold-5-price-launch-availability-specifications-features-8758199?utm_source=openai))

- Honor Magic V6
  - Why consider it: ultra-slim, flagship foldable with a huge battery and strong cooling/AI features; premium option in Asia.
  - Availability: announced at MWC 2026 and said to roll out in select markets in H2 2026 (regional availability to be confirmed). ([honor.com](https://www.honor.com/global/news/honor-magic-v6-launch/?utm_source=openai))

- OPPO Find N5 (older but still widely available in some markets)
  - Why consider it: strong “foldable book” design with good balance of features and price in several Asian markets; still a relevant option in countries where it’s stocked.
  - Availability: launched in Asia in early 2025; still sold in some markets (e.g., Singapore). ([oppo.com](https://www.oppo.com/sg/newsroom/press/oppo-launches-find-n5/?utm_source=openai))

Notes and caveats
- Xiaomi Mix Fold 4 is largely China-first and not widely available outside China; there’s no broad international rollout reported as of mid-2026. If you need something widely available across Asia, it’s less dependable. ([gizmochina.com](https://www.gizmochina.com/2024/07/03/exclusive-xiaomi-mix-fold-4-wont-be-launched-internationally/?utm_source=openai))

If you share your exact country (and approximate budget), I’ll narrow this to a short list of the best current options for your location, plus current street prices and where to buy (official store vs. carriers vs. authorized retailers).
